Compare University of Edinburgh to Competitors

University of Glasgow

University of Glasgow operates as a prestigious institution focused on education and research in various academic disciplines. It offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and online study programs, as well as short courses and continuing professional development opportunities. The university is also known for its world-changing research and commitment to sustainability. It was founded in 1451 and is based in Glasgow, Scotland.

U
University of Aberdeen

The University of Aberdeen is a research university. It offers courses include graduate, post-graduate, and online programs. It provides courses for various subjects such as mathematics, business administration, and humanities. University of Aberdeen was founded in 1495 and is based in Aberdeen, Scotland.

University of Sheffield

University of Sheffield operates as a research university. It offers educational programs including undergraduate courses, postgraduate taught courses, doctor of philosophy (PhD) study, apprenticeship opportunities, and online learning. It contributes to research and development in areas such as biotechnology and sustainable aviation. University of Sheffield was formerly known as University College of Sheffield. It was founded in 1897 and is based in Sheffield, United Kingdom.

University of York

The University of York is a member of the Russell Group, focusing on education across various academic disciplines. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs, as well as options for academic research and professional development. The university engages in global collaborations and partnerships to address global challenges. It was founded in 1963 and is based in York, England.

University of Birmingham

University of Birmingham operates as a university that focuses on higher education and research across various disciplines. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs, as well as short courses, related to knowledge and professional development. The university engages in research projects fostering intercultural communication, exploring creative arts, and advancing the immersive experience sector. It was founded in 1900 and is based in Birmingham, United Kingdom.

University of Bristol

University of Bristol operates as a higher education institution, providing undergraduate and postgraduate education, and conducts research across various disciplines. The university offers degree programs and is involved in research that addresses global challenges. It serves students seeking higher education and those interested in academic research. University of Bristol was formerly known as University College, Bristol. It was founded in 1876 and is based in Bristol, United Kingdom.
